visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen view. On the left, a hand pours a green can of 7-Up into a glass filled with ice and lemon slices. On the right, a man with short black hair in a blue denim shirt eats noodles from a sizzling hot plate. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with wooden booth seating and blurred patrons in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the restaurant interior, featuring a modern architectural design with wooden lattice ceilings, warm ambient lighting, and turquoise upholstered booths. The man is then shown holding a yellow egg tart, smiling brightly at the camera while yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) A close-up view of a bakery display case reveals dozens of golden-yellow egg tarts arranged in neat rows. A neon sign in the background glows with Chinese characters, and the man is seen briefly walking past the exterior glass windows of the shop. (4) Back at the table, the man examines a colorful, detailed paper menu. He is filmed in a medium shot as he enthusiastically slurps long noodles and eats large, thick slices of beef. He uses silver chopsticks and a spoon, showing exaggerated expressions of satisfaction. (5) The camera focuses on a thick piece of golden-brown French toast on a white plate. A knife and fork are used to cut it open, revealing a filling of ham and scrambled eggs inside. The man takes a massive bite, looking directly at the lens with an expressive, surprised face. (6) A close-up shows a hand vigorously mashing a salted lemon at the bottom of a glass with a metal spoon before pouring more 7-Up over it. Another man in a dark green shirt is introduced; he drinks from the straw and pulls a sour, shocked facial expression while others laugh. (7) The final phase shows the main creator biting into an egg tart again. Detailed store information including the address and phone number is overlaid on the left side of the frame in white and red text. The background remains the lively, well-lit restaurant environment as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, medium-tempo pop background track featuring electronic synth and a steady drum beat. A male narrator Ethan speaks with a high arousal level and energetic delivery. His voice is clear and professional, with a friendly tone and moderate speech rate. No ambient noise is heard. (2) As the narrator discusses the noodles, a sharp, percussive sizzling sound of a hot iron plate is introduced, layered over the continuous BGM. Ethan’s pitch variability increases as he expresses excitement. The vocals are front-centered with high clarity. (3) The rhythmic clinking of silver chopsticks against a ceramic bowl is clearly audible. A distinct slurping sound occurs when the narrator eats, followed by a soft vocal 'Mmm' signifying enjoyment. The BGM remains at a steady volume, slightly ducked under the speech. (4) A metallic clinking and scraping sound of a knife and fork on a plate signifies the cutting of the toast. Ethan’s voice maintains a narrative style, with clear articulation and few pauses. The ambient restaurant floor is represented by a very faint room tone. (5) A liquid splashing and fizzing sound is heard as the soda is poured into the glass, followed by the percussive sound of a spoon mashing ice and fruit. Ethan asks a question with a prominent rising intonation and high pitch. (6) A second male voice responds with a strained, slightly muffled tone, followed by the sound of light group laughter and a vocal reaction. The BGM swells slightly for the outro, maintaining its energetic tempo until the track fades out at the end.
